name: n8n
desc: Self-hostable node-based workflow automation with code escape hatches. Use when Zapier gets expensive or the data cannot leave your server.

name: Zapier
desc: Hosted integrations between thousands of SaaS apps. Use when the glue matters more than the cost per task.

name: Make
desc: Visual scenario builder with branching and iterators. Use for multi-step business flows non-developers must edit.

name: Windmill
desc: Turns scripts into workflows, UIs and cron jobs. Use when your automations are really code that needs a front door.

name: Apache Airflow
desc: DAG scheduler for batch data pipelines. Use when nightly jobs have dependencies and must be retried and audited.

name: Dagster
desc: Asset-oriented orchestration with typed inputs and lineage. Use when you want to reason about data assets, not tasks.

name: Prefect
desc: Python-native flows with dynamic DAGs. Use when pipelines are ordinary functions you want observability over.

name: Airbyte
desc: Open-source connectors that replicate sources into a warehouse. Use to avoid writing yet another API extractor.

name: Fivetran
desc: Managed ELT with maintained connectors and schema drift handling. Use when nobody wants to own pipeline breakage.

name: Apache Spark
desc: Distributed processing for very large datasets. Use when the data no longer fits on one machine.

name: Apache Kafka
desc: Durable partitioned event log that many consumers replay. Use as the backbone of event-driven architectures.

name: RabbitMQ
desc: Classic message broker with rich routing. Use for task distribution when Kafka is more than you need.

name: NATS
desc: Very light pub/sub and streaming with tiny operational overhead. Use for microservice chatter and IoT fleets.

name: Amazon SQS
desc: Managed queue with dead-letter handling and no servers. Use on AWS when you just need work to not get lost.

name: Temporal
desc: Durable workflows that survive crashes and resume where they stopped. Use for long multi-step business processes like onboarding or payouts.

name: Trigger.dev
desc: Long-running background jobs and schedules for TypeScript apps. Use when serverless timeouts keep killing your work.

name: cron
desc: The scheduler already on the server. Use for nightly scripts before reaching for anything with a dashboard.
